reviews.x: My husband has thick curly hair and he loves these headbands. They are tight enough to hold his hair back so far and the material is nice and thick.
My husband has thick curly hair and he loves these headbands. They are tight enough to hold his hair back so far and the material is nice and thick.

I have a 21" hat size.. most hats fit bug on me. This hairband fits very snug so I assume it will be too tight on a lot of other people with average to large head sizes or if they have very tick volomunous hair. Quality of the material is very good, and the colors are crisp and vibrant.

This is a great headband. HOWEVER if you have a big head, this is not for you. I have a big head (plus locs) and this SQUEEZES my head and hurts that soft spot between my head/neck where the back band sits. Its a good product. Just, be honest with yourself about your head size!

reviews.t: LOVE these, they are perfect for workouts:)!
reviews.x: Not a fan of headbands in general, they’ve always caused me headaches...BUT I started doing cardio kickboxing classes, they are an hr long and the sweat was pouring down my face into my eyes and messing with my glasses....saw these and thought I’d give them a try.....absolutely LOVE LOVE LOVE these, not tight but stay in place and really do soak up the sweat, NOT a drop ran down my face, they don’t generate any heat....I would highly recommend these, they are perfect:)!!

Love the band width BUT I have a fairly small woman's head and my hair isn't very thick but these give me a headache because they are too tight. I've tried wearing them all. Bummer because the look is exactly what I wanted. I'm not sure how to stretch them out, maybe I'll try cutting some of stretchy elastic near the nape of the neck. Sounds like the sizing on these is pretty inconsistent.

This would be a great purchase if I could use the headbands without getting a headache. After a while they feel tight. I am in the process of stretching them out to see if I could use them for a longer period of time. Hope this helps someone.

reviews.t: once on your head. these headbands wont go anywhere ...
reviews.x: once on your head. these headbands wont go anywhere. a little tight at first but after a couple of uses, they will stretch and adjust.

Maybe I just have a big head, but these are a bit tight. That has its positives and negatives. They definitely keep ALL my hair out of my face when I need them to, like for a facemask or whatever. It's just a little uncomfortable for too long.
I have short hair and these work very well to keep my hair out of my fave for various activities. If anyone wants a head band that doesn't slip off these might be for you!

reviews.t: These are made of nice material and i really wanted to like them
reviews.x: These are made of nice material and i really wanted to like them. Unfortunately they were to tight and needed to return them, as they were giving me a headache.
Don't buy these. They are very cheaply made. All 3 had holes in the seam. I would return them except my return window closed.

reviews.t: Much Too Tight For Man With Average-To-Small Head
reviews.x: I agree with other reviewers here about them being too tight.  I am a man with an average-to-small head and these are too tight.  I was excited to see something that wasn't too "girly" that I could wear since I am growing my hair out and this keeps the hair out of my eyes and helps on my many "awkward" days that comes with growing hair out until it is long enough for a ponytail.  It's too bad because the material feels nice and I like the versatility of being able to have a narro

reviews.t: Quality of the material is pretty good, but quality of the stitching is questionable
reviews.x: One of the headbands had a manufacturing defect.  Part the seam was not sewn together, so there is a big hole on the top.  The second I opened seems ok.  Haven't opened the third yet.  Quality of the material is pretty good, but quality of the stitching is questionable.

reviews.t: These headbands are perfect for my natural updo's
reviews.x: These headbands are perfect for my natural updo's!  When I'm having a lazy hair day, I just pin my hair up in the back and leave my curls hanging in the front.  My natural hair covers the thin part of the headband and it looks like a cute headscarf in the back!!

these headbands are life!!!!!!! they feel soft and are super durable, I must order more!!!! I only wear these headbands because I have such thick hair and never feel like doing it so this hides my laziness! 🤣

reviews.t: These are great! I love the thicker bands
reviews.x: These are great! I love the thicker bands! Definitely helps keep my hair down and back, and they don't move too much when working out. They're great!

reviews.t: Great Quality, we purchased these for my employees
reviews.x: Great Quality, we purchased these for my employees, we own a cleaning company. We actually put vinyl on them with our logo and they look very nice.
Perfect thickness for embroidery. Light weight and breathable.
Very cheaply made and arrived damaged. I returned them.

I bought these to replace headwraps I had that were getting very old.  These are great!  I have an extra big head and the elastic never fits on any headband, so I had to cut the elastic and restitch to my head size (I just hold them on with snap clips) but this is in no reflection of the product.  I just have an enormous noggin, so I can't report if they would fit on a normal person sized head.  They are super comfy and very pleasant.  I am very happy with my purchase, and with getting three! wo

These are cheaply made and there is no stretch in the headband itself. Does not fit properly and leaves gaps around my face due to the fabric being more like a t-shirt rather than a spandex material like most headbands. I own dozens of headbands, and this is by far the worst one I've bought. And just in case you don't like ONE of the headbands, they send you THREE others just like it, so you have more to throw in the trash or use as a rag later

These might be a bit thick for my purposes, I just got them to keep my hair back at work, but I think they're going to work really well. The material is not light at all, so I'm sure they'll hold up to lots of use, and for having a BIG bit of elastic on the back, they're not super tight. They might actually stay on without giving me a headache, which is a bit of a unicorn. Overall, not perfect, but definitely no regrets for that price.

reviews.t: No more sweat in the eye
reviews.x: I like that there were different color options but just having simple was perfect. Just really needed something to wear to the gym as I seem to be the unfortunate person that sweats a lot. Not fun getting sweat than your eye every few seconds. So this working out so well maybe really happy. It lasted it the whole 2 hours of the gym. Stayed put. And if you are into wearing headbands for stylish reasons I could see these looking nice

reviews.t: The fabric is super soft and is good quality
reviews.x: The fabric is super soft and is good quality. They do not stretch an enormous amount, which is nice because they actually stay on your head. I think i will end up using these while working out. It wasn't quite the "look" I exactly wanted. I would say that these would probably be a little too feminine for guys.. and not quite pretty enough to be considered girly.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the headbands too tight, causing headaches or discomfort, especially for those with larger heads or thick hair.
Several reviewers praise the material quality, describing it as nice, thick, and good quality.
Some reviewers report manufacturing defects such as holes in the seams or stitching issues.
Reviewers appreciate that the headbands hold hair securely in place and don't slip off during activities.
A few reviewers note that the headbands stretch and adjust after a couple of uses.
